name: Autonomism
summary: Autonomism is a far-left, anti-authoritarian Marxist current that grew in 1960s-70s Italy and treats working-class struggle, not capital's development, as the motor of history. It rejects party and union mediation and the state, expands the working class to the whole 'social factory' of precarious, student, domestic and migrant labour, and favours direct action, refusal of work, a social wage and horizontal self-organisation. Post-operaist writers such as Hardt and Negri carry this into a global politics of the multitude, exodus and absolute democracy.
scope: Italian operaismo (Tronti, Panzieri, Alquati), Autonomia (Potere Operaio, Autonomia Operaia, Negri) and post-operaismo (Hardt and Negri's Empire and Multitude), with autonomist feminism (Dalla Costa, Federici, James) and later autonomist anarchism noted as variants. Excludes the German Autonomen's and insurrectionary strands where they differ, and the Leninist party tradition.

sources.author: Wikipedia
sources.usedFor: Post-operaist positions on global citizenship, guaranteed income, end of national conflict, nation-states in Empire.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Autonomists oppose capitalist markets as mechanisms of command over labour and see the market and state as complicit forms of domination.

unions-good.rationale: Autonomists broke with unions as mediators that reintegrate dissent and hold only the tactical moment of struggle, favouring autonomous rank-and-file organisation.

property-fundamental.rationale: Squatting, self-reduction and rent strikes deliberately override property claims in practice.

cut-welfare.rationale: They demand a social wage and campaigned for wages for housework; cutting welfare is the opposite of the demand.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Autonomists are anti-state and treat counter-terror policing as a regime of biopower used against movements.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Anti-authoritarian counterculture milieus (Radio Alice, free parties) lean libertarian on personal conduct; not a core doctrinal point.

strong-leader.rationale: Horizontal, non-authoritarian organisation and rejection of sovereign command make a strong leader contrary to the core.

state-harmful.rationale: Autonomist anarchism is strongly anti-state, and Hardt and Negri treat sovereign states as constituted power complicit in domination; Marxist strands are less absolute. None of the cited sources takes up this statement, so this is a low-confidence reading of the general outlook.

limit-guns.rationale: No doctrinal position; autonomists oppose state monopoly on force but have no gun-control stance.

empower-police-military.rationale: Police and military are instruments of the state that autonomists confront and want to abolish or neutralise.

decide-locally.rationale: Preference for horizontal, self-managed local organisation, though the multitude is global rather than localist.

traditional-family.rationale: Autonomist feminism, including Wages for Housework, attacks the unpaid labour built into the family as capital's foundation.

abortion-legal.rationale: Autonomist feminism asserts women's control over reproduction as part of the struggle over reproductive labour.

more-religion-public.rationale: A secular, anti-authoritarian far left with no religious politics.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Autonomists see national conflict as ending in Empire and oppose national identity politics; culture is a field of the common instead.

gradual-change.rationale: The tradition seeks rupture and continuous struggle and distrusts established institutions that co-opt it.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Hardt and Negri demand global citizenship, and autonomists see migrant labour as part of the multitude.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: They see UN and similar bodies as parts of Empire's ruling structure, not of a counter-power.

nation-first.rationale: Autonomism is internationalist and treats national conflict as obsolete.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Hardt and Negri treat contemporary war as biopower and police action of Empire; autonomists are anti-imperialist.

open-borders.rationale: Global citizenship is one of the demands in Empire.

limit-growth.rationale: Operaismo is productivist about workers' power while later strands are ecological; split.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Anti-capitalist milieus (ZAD, autonomous movements) join ecological struggles, though by direct action, not state programmes.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Technology is seen as a terrain of struggle with potential for the multitude, but not as a solution independent of class power.

revolution-justified.rationale: Revolutionary rupture is the stated goal, and Potere Operaio even argued for insurrection and an armed party.

experts-over-public.rationale: The working class and multitude are themselves the source of knowledge; Tronti insists on analysis from the class standpoint.

socialized-markets.rationale: The tradition is indifferent to market socialism design and aims past markets altogether; split.

basic-income.rationale: A guaranteed income or social wage for all is one of Hardt and Negri's three demands, and a social wage was a core Negri demand.

state-directs-investment.rationale: State direction is capital's strategy of restructuring, which autonomists read as a response to workers' struggle.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: They want to abolish wage labour via refusal of work, but simultaneously demand a social wage now; adherents split on money.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Tripartite state-recognised bargaining is the integration of workers into capital that autonomists broke with.

one-party-rule.rationale: They rejected the Communist Party's centralised leadership and favoured horizontal networks.

democracy-best.rationale: Hardt and Negri champion absolute democracy but critique representative liberal democracy; qualified agreement.

direct-votes.rationale: Preference for horizontal and assembly forms over representation; absolute democracy is stressed.

workers-councils.rationale: Council-style autonomous organisation is closer to their politics than parliaments, though autonomists avoid prescribing a state form.

natural-rulers.rationale: Contradicts the core egalitarian and anti-hierarchical commitment.

political-violence-never.rationale: The movement included armed groups and insurrectional doctrine, and sabotage and black bloc tactics are accepted.

war-builds-character.rationale: They reject war and see it as a regime of biopower and of capitalist states.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Opposes both state coercion and capitalist command, so privatised force is rejected.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Rejects nation-based identities in favour of the multitude and global citizenship.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Tronti makes working-class struggle the driver of capital's development; capital moves in response to it.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Their politics is built on the common and collaboration.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Anti-authoritarian and anti-communitarian-order; collective duty over rights is rejected.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Ecological strands exist but the tradition does not take a stated position.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Hardt and Negri see new communications technology as enabling the multitude and look to subvert, not halt, capitalist development.

human-enhancement.rationale: The cyborg theme appears, but no stated position on enhancement freedom.

restore-past-order.rationale: Rejects restorative politics, which Tronti sees as capital reacting to class struggle.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Tronti demands a rigorously one-sided class logic, rejecting neutral pragmatism.

direct-action.rationale: Squatting, rent strikes, sabotage and self-reduction were their method, and they are explicitly outside parliamentary politics.

means-match-ends.rationale: The horizontal, non-authoritarian form of organisation is itself the aim, as the movement prefigures the society it wants.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Never advocated; the tradition builds on workers' struggle inside advanced capitalism.

distribute-by-need.rationale: A social wage independent of work is an operaist demand and follows from refusing the work-wage link.

production-for-use.rationale: Opposes capitalist production for command over labour; autonomists want production that serves the common.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Marxist premise taken from Capital and read from the class standpoint.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Tronti mentions a dictatorship of workers, but later autonomists reject a state-form rule over classes and favour horizontalism.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Hardt and Negri see global war as a regime of Empire, rather than inter-imperial rivalry in the Leninist sense; qualified.

taxation-theft.rationale: They support a social wage and reappropriation, so rejecting taxation as theft would be contrary.

harm-principle.rationale: Libertarian on personal conduct but not framed in terms of harm principle; split.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The multitude and the common are collective subjects, rather than individual rights holders only.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Exodus is a central concept, but adherents also demand absolute democracy and voice; split.

state-as-business.rationale: Rejects both state and business command.

media-academia-power.rationale: A right-populist claim; autonomists see capital and the state as the powers, though they note knowledge's role.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Contradicts the tradition's egalitarianism and anti-racism.

total-state.rationale: Wikipedia describes the movement as committed to 'anti-capitalist, anti-state, horizontal, and anti-authoritarian struggle', the opposite of a state directing all of life.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Autonomists are internationalist and anti-imperialist, and see national conflict as ending in Empire.

bound-labor.rationale: Contradicts the refusal of work and the demand for worker autonomy.

single-common-good.rationale: Politics is framed through class antagonism, though the common is an organising concept; split.

revive-national-language.rationale: No relevance beyond hostility to nation-building.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Workers' self-organisation in the factory is the stated starting point, though they prefer autonomy to formal codetermination.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: No stated view; capital's austerity is opposed, so deficit-avoidance is rejected.

economic-freedom.rationale: Capitalist economic freedom is the form of domination they oppose.

force-without-un.rationale: Opposes imperial wars and war as a norm of biopower.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Secular, but Hardt and Negri draw on Spinoza and Foucault rather than a rationalist creed; no stated position.

work-for-welfare.rationale: The refusal of work and unconditional social wage reject work conditions.

class-collaboration.rationale: Tronti's non-cooperation and continuous struggle reject partnership between classes.

dominated-front.rationale: Anti-imperialist but they see Empire as global rather than a Western bloc, and oppose nationalism; split.

workers-nation.rationale: Tronti stresses workers' international unity against a unified world market.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Autonomist feminists such as Dalla Costa argued that women's unwaged domestic labour reproduces capital and launched Wages for Housework against that gendered division of roles. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

ban-interest.rationale: Debt and money are targets of struggle, but a legal ban on interest is not part of the tradition; no position.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Tronti speaks of capital's class dictatorship and the state as its instrument; the reading is more complicit than purely instrumental.

elite-replacement.rationale: A conspiracy theory contrary to the migrant solidarity of the tradition.

national-mission.rationale: Spreading a national form of government is imperial, which autonomists oppose.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Wages for Housework, the autonomist feminist current, held that women's unpaid reproductive labour systematically disadvantages them.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Contradicts the egalitarian and anti-state stance.

night-watchman-state.rationale: The movement is described as both anti-capitalist and anti-state, and its squatting, rent strikes and self-reduction attacked the property rights a minimal state exists to protect.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: A question of religious personal law that the tradition never addressed, and its anti-state side cuts both ways.

trade-surplus.rationale: Mercantilism is a national capitalist project.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Many autonomists accept sabotage and insurrectional force; but libertarian non-aggression is not their principle.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Cooperation and the common drive history, with class struggle as the engine.

separated-powers.rationale: Treated as constituted power; they favour constituent power instead.

vanguard-party.rationale: They rejected the Leninist party model; Tronti wants workers to lead and the party to follow, and the autonomous movement rejected the PCI.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Hardt and Negri treat the poor as the common name of the multitude; not a stated policy principle.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Strikes and continuous struggle are the basic weapon.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Rejects Malthusian reading; poverty derives from capitalist social relations.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Hardt and Negri celebrate the multitude's differences.

party-controls-media.rationale: Autonomia Creativa was heavily involved in the Free Radio movement, with Radio Alice in Bologna its best-known station, building media outside the control of state and party.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Global citizenship rules out long waiting periods before full rights.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Representation is opposed at root; split.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: The autonomia is hostile to disciplined party structures.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Contradicts Radio Alice culture and libertarian milieu.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Rent strikes and squats oppose landlords, but universal ownership is not their aim; split.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Populist claim; autonomists include students in the working class.

death-penalty.rationale: Opposes state killing and the carceral state.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Global citizenship rejects blood-based membership in a state.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Constituent power is central, but formal assemblies are a representative form; split.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Contradicts anti-authoritarianism and the refusal of work.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Anti-militarist and hostile to state military power of any kind.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Rejects sovereign head of state generally.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: The common is a key concept, beyond a common-good justification of property.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Operaismo grew from Johnson-Forest and Socialisme ou Barbarie, which analysed the USSR as state capitalism.

precautionary-principle.rationale: No documented position; ecological milieus might agree, but the doctrine is silent.

character-from-environment.rationale: Materialist view: subjectivity is produced in social relations of production.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Marxist base but with a working-class-led reading; autonomists stress subjective class struggle over structure, so qualified.

no-bailouts.rationale: They oppose bailouts as subsidies to capital but would not endorse market discipline; split.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Some strands (armed party) agree; the mainstream emphasises mass movements; split.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Egalitarian, anti-sovereign politics opposes inherited rank; not specifically discussed.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Wikipedia traces the tradition to currents that criticised both imperialism and Stalinism, and colonial tutelage is the imperial logic they attacked.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Tronti says capital adapts through its response to struggle but is not immune; split.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Cultivating influence over former colonies is imperial, which is contrary to their anti-imperialism.

delink-world-market.rationale: Hardt and Negri stress a global multitude within Empire, not national delinking.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Operaismo extends the working class to all and rejects the labour-aristocracy thesis, treating the whole society as productive.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Rejects parliaments as the basis of power.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Exodus is withdrawal from sovereignty, but engaged struggle outside parliament is central.

paid-care-work.rationale: Autonomist feminists took up the social wage to launch the Wages for Housework movement in 1972.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Empire argues imperialism between nations has given way to a global capital exploiting labour everywhere, so a core-periphery transfer story is not their frame.

native-born-offices.rationale: Empire proposes global citizenship, which rules out reserving offices by birth.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Empire holds that nation-states and national conflicts are being superseded, and autonomists reject the state, so territorial claims are opposed.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Autonomism is anti-state and anti-authoritarian, and Hardt and Negri oppose Empire's wars; a political army is rejected.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Delegates bound to the community and removable at any time fit the anti-representation, council-style democracy of Autonomia and the absolute democracy of the multitude.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Autonomists demand a social wage and decommodified reproduction, the opposite of privatised individual retirement accounts.

foreign-land-ownership.rationale: Empire proposes global citizenship, so barring foreigners from owning land contradicts the rights autonomists claim for everyone.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: Empire ends national conflict and opposes imperial domination, and autonomists reject the state, so great-power intervention against allies is rejected.

corporate-influence.rationale: Autonomists see the state as an instrument of capital, so corporate capture of government is a basic premise.

job-guarantee.rationale: Refusal of work is central, so they prefer a social wage to a state-provided job.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Anti-state direct action, sabotage and illegalism show no general duty to obey the law.

industrial-unions.rationale: Autonomists reject union mediation, so the form of union organisation is not their concern.

informal-organisation.rationale: They reject permanent parties and unions in favour of horizontal self-organisation and direct action.

religious-nation.rationale: Secular, internationalist Marxism rejects a religious definition of the nation.

defeat-communism.rationale: Autonomists are communists who reject both Cold War blocs, and see communism as the movement's goal.

women-equality-needs-economic-change.rationale: Autonomist feminists argued that unpaid domestic labour underpins capitalism, as in Wages for Housework.

socialized-care.rationale: Autonomist feminists demanded wages and commons for care work, so socialisation versus payment splits adherents.

cooperative-communities.rationale: Horizontal self-organisation and the commons are core to autonomist politics.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Autonomists reject both capitalism and Soviet-style state communism, favouring self-organisation.

holocaust-denial.rationale: A far-left anti-fascist current has no use for denial of the Holocaust; this follows from its anti-authoritarian, internationalist core rather than a stated text.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Autonomists reject the state and party mediation and favour horizontal self-organisation, so repressing opposition is the opposite of their politics.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Empire presents imperial sovereignty as the enemy and favours the multitude's global citizenship, so ruling territories for the metropole is rejected.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Hardt and Negri's 'absolute democracy' of the multitude and autonomist self-management call for direct participation in decisions rather than delegated authority.

intersecting-oppressions.rationale: Autonomist feminism (Dalla Costa, Federici, James) tied class, gender and race through the social factory, though the doctrine is class-centred.

alienated-labor.rationale: The refusal of work and the 'social factory' analysis treat capitalist labour as expropriating workers' creative and social capacities.

islam-incompatible.rationale: A far-left internationalist current favouring global citizenship and the multitude rejects the idea that Islam clashes with Western values.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: A secular Marxist current locates authority in the multitude, not in God.

rich-first.rationale: The movement is egalitarian and rejects capital's leading the development of the working class; letting some grow rich first runs against its core.

property-franchise.rationale: Autonomists want radical democracy and expanded citizenship for all, so restricting the vote by wealth is the opposite of Empire's global-citizenship demand.

reification.rationale: Marxist-derived analysis of capital as a social relation that rules over workers is taken for granted, though autonomists emphasise struggle over fetishism.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Autonomists hold formal liberties hollow under capital's control of media and space, and ran their own radio and social centres in response.

racial-franchise.rationale: Empire proposes global citizenship with full rights for all residents, which rules out any racial restriction of the franchise.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: The current favours horizontal self-organisation and the multitude over consociational elite bargaining; no direct position, so split.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Autonomism is anti-authoritarian and rejects the state and militarised discipline, so uniformed youth training for national service is firmly rejected.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Autonomism demands a social wage and the refusal of work, rejecting income that rewards ownership, and holds that value is created by living labour.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Autonomism is internationalist and rejects nationalism as an ideology, so claims of national identity running unbroken from antiquity are firmly rejected.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Autonomism is secular and anti-nationalist, so honouring those who die for the nation as martyrs and saints is firmly rejected.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Autonomism is a materialist Marxist current that sees politics as class struggle, not a spiritual contest between good and evil.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Autonomism rejects nationalism and ethnic hierarchy and holds in its migrant-labour politics that no group should hold economic power by national origin.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Autonomism treats working-class struggle as the motor of history and puts real power in workers' own hands.

soldiers-refuse-war.rationale: Refusal and non-cooperation are central tactics, and Hardt and Negri treat war as an instrument of Empire to be resisted.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Autonomists see unions as mediators that reintegrate dissent and prefer refusal of work and autonomous rank-and-file organisation to bargaining, though workplace collective action is itself valued.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Autonomism is anti-state and favours autonomous organs of working-class power over taking over the existing state; Hardt and Negri propose absolute democracy outside constituted power.

sacred-nation.rationale: Autonomists reject nationalism and the nation-state, with Empire arguing national conflicts are ended in global citizenship.

workers-own-party.rationale: Autonomism rejects party and union mediation and holds that workers organise autonomously outside parties.

immigrants-learn-language.rationale: Autonomism treats migrant labour as part of the social factory and the multitude, opposing coercive integration demands.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Hardt and Negri call for 'absolute democracy' of the multitude and criticise representative government as a mere form, so electoral procedure alone is not democracy.

premarital-sex.rationale: Autonomist feminism (Dalla Costa, Federici) and the movement's anti-moralist, liberationist politics treat sexual autonomy as a given; the statement is stated loosely in the sources.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Autonomists see networked communication as a ground of the multitude's self-organisation and oppose state control of it; shutdowns would be repression.

women-suffrage.rationale: Autonomist feminism puts women's equality at the centre and the movement assumes full political rights for women.

race-social-construct.rationale: Hardt and Negri treat race as a construct of imperial command and the movement rejects biological racial hierarchy.

defend-planned-state.rationale: Autonomists are anti-state and reject the Leninist party, so they would not defend a bureaucratically ruled planned state.

national-church-status.rationale: The current is anti-state and anti-authoritarian, so legal privilege for a state church is rejected.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Autonomists reject nationalism and the nation-state; Hardt and Negri see the end of national conflict in Empire and a global multitude.

protect-kin-minorities.rationale: Ethnic-national kin-state protection contradicts its rejection of nations and borders and its support for migrants.

resources-common-ownership.rationale: Hardt and Negri's 'the common' holds natural and social wealth in common against private and public appropriation, matching the claim that appropriators owe compensation.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: Autonomism rejects party and union mediation but wants horizontal self-organisation and absolute democracy, not a leader standing above the people.

national-resource-control.rationale: Autonomists favour commons over nationalisation, and reject national framing; control by the nation-state is not their aim, though foreign corporate control is also opposed.

automate-paid-work.rationale: Refusal of work and a social wage detached from jobs are core autonomist demands, and the post-operaist view welcomes technology that frees time from wage labour.

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Operaismo is a Marxist current that places labour at the root of capital's value, though post-operaists rework the theory for immaterial labour.

market-under-party-rule.rationale: Autonomists reject the party form and the state as mediators of the class and favour horizontal self-organisation.

missingStatements.text: Everyone should be guaranteed a social wage that is not tied to having a job.
missingStatements.rationale: Negri's social wage demand fed Wages for Housework, and a guaranteed income is among the demands in Empire.

missingStatements.text: Unpaid domestic and care work should be recognised and paid as labour.
missingStatements.rationale: Autonomist feminists took up the social wage to launch the Wages for Housework movement in 1972.

missingStatements.text: Capital's authority in the workplace should be met with refusal of work and non-cooperation rather than bargaining.
missingStatements.rationale: Tronti describes planned non-cooperation and organised passivity as the working class's current form of struggle.

missingStatements.text: Everyone living in a country should have the rights of a full citizen, wherever they were born.
missingStatements.rationale: Global citizenship is one of the three rights proposed in Empire.

missingStatements.text: Empty buildings and land should be occupied and run by those who need them, even against the owner's will.
missingStatements.rationale: Squatting, rent strikes and self-managed social centres were routine autonomist practice.

notes: Strands differ: armed-party and insurrectional currents (Potere Operaio, later groups) answer violence and arms questions more affirmatively than the mainstream, and autonomist anarchism is more absolutely anti-state than Hardt and Negri. Many answers on policy details are inferred and low confidence.
